en: The postcard features a stylized, vintage illustration depicting a snow-covered landscape with a stone and thatch-roofed alpine hut. In the foreground, three figures dressed in early 20th-century winter attire are gathered, with skis visible, suggesting a winter sports context. The background is dominated by rolling snow hills under a yellow sky. The text is in a decorative, Gothic-style script.
